# CS2Inspect Documentation

> CS2Inspect is a full-stack Nuxt 4 web application for Counter-Strike 2 players to customize and manage their in-game item loadouts with real-time preview. Built with Vue 3, Naive UI, Tailwind CSS, Pinia, Nitro (H3), MariaDB, and Drizzle ORM. Authentication via Steam OpenID + JWT. Deployed with Docker images on Coolify.

## API Reference

- [Loadouts](https://sak0a.github.io/cs2inspect-web/api/loadouts): CRUD operations for loadout management
- [Items](https://sak0a.github.io/cs2inspect-web/api/items): Item configuration and customization endpoints
